full_judgment:
8. Mr. S. Rashed Jahangir, appeared on behalf of the respondent No.2 by filling an affidavit-in-opposition submits that the original allottee Dr. S.A. Monem left the house in question immediate after the war of liberation and his whereabouts were not known to the government. As the allottee ceased to manage, control or supervise the case property in person; the property has been declared as an abandoned property as per Article 2(1) of the President's Order No.16 of 1972. Later on, it was published in the Gazette on 23.9,1986 under the category of "Kha" list. He also submits that the enlistment as an abandoned property under Section 5(2) of the Ordinance LIV of 1985 is the conclusive evidence of fact, The petitioner could not establish his claim by adducing oral and documentary evidence rebutting the presumption of correctness of abandon character and also failed to produce of the original lease deed, and the subsequent registered deed of sale before the court of Settlement. So the Court of Settlement has rightly and lawfully dismissed the Settlement Case. The impugned judgment and order does not call for any interference. 

 On perusal of the aforesaid orders it become clear that the petitioner did neither adduce any oral of documentary evidence before the Court of Settlement nor filed any original documents to rebut presumption that the case house is not an abandoned property.
